All else = iter-3 exactly (itnet_k=3, alpha_init=0.0037, lr=1e-4, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42); max_train_s lowered 900 -> 780 as a tighter train backstop for the slower c=24 net. The epochs lever has PLATEAUED: iter-2 ep14 -> iter-3 ep18 gave hr +0.0022 only (0.310054 -> 0.312282) AND SSIM DROPPED (0.908534 -> 0.904773). iter-3's own falsifier (hr <= 0.310 at ep18 => capacity-limited) effectively FIRED -> itnet_v3 is CAPACITY-limited at unet_c=16, not training-convergence-limited. unet_c=16 is the current capacity; epochs=18 is the current count. (2) LIMITER NOW = model CAPACITY at c=16 (epochs plateaued AND iter-3 used 17.88/20 min so epochs cannot be raised further inside the wall anyway). (3) ONE KNOB: unet_c 16 -> 24 (params 3.70M -> ~8.3M, ~2.25x conv FLOPs). epochs traded DOWN 18 -> 9 to keep train+score inside 1200s. itnet_v3 is the END-TO-END unrolled variant (unlike v1/v2's pretrain-denoiser-then-DC), so added denoiser capacity is trained against the full recon objective and should genuinely lift the ceiling. (4) HYPOTHESIS: more denoiser capacity (c=24) lifts hr above 0.3123 even at only 9 epochs, because the c=16 net had saturated its representational headroom (ep14->18 flat). FALSIFIER (NUMBERS): if hr <= 0.3123 at c=24/ep9, itnet_v3 has hit its representational ceiling on this 214-slice val set (added capacity does not help OR 9 epochs is too few to train the bigger net) -> iter-5 must either give the bigger net more epochs (trade train_n down to buy them) or pivot to lr/itnet_k. (5) BUDGET (HARD 20-min = 1200s train+score), CAPACITY-vs-EPOCHS trade math: measured c=16 timing over 3 points (8,737.85),(14,1010.07),(18,1072.94) gives full-span per-epoch (1072.94-737.85)/(18-8)=33.5 s/epoch and fixed cost (data load + per-sample-ps projector cache + 214-slice per-sample val + figure + startup) 737.85-8*33.5=469.8 s. Conservative split (UNet ~half of per-epoch train, half is projector/data; only ~25pct of fixed is the c-scaling val UNet-forward): per-epoch@c24 ~= 52-60 s, fixed@c24 ~= 631 s. At epochs=9: 631 + 9*~56 = ~1135s = 18.9 min < 1200s even pessimistically (unet_share=0.6 case = 19.57 min, still OK); epochs=10 risks the wall in the pessimistic case (20.6 min), epochs=8 wastes headroom. So epochs=9 is the largest count that the c=24 timing safely permits inside 20 min. max_train_s=780 fences the train phase (9*~56=~504s expected, well under 780) so a finite recon + 214-slice val + figure always land inside the 30-min sbatch wall. val stays ALL 214 L277 slices, 321px detector-geometry FOV (evaluate_calibrated default for AGENT4CT_DATASET=mayo_ldct_2d; no fov= override). grad_clip=1.0 retained (mandatory: the 2304-view Mayo FBP adjoint inside dc_step overflows otherwise). HARD-WIRED (unchanged): staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps FBP init + per-sample itnet.projector swap for the k=3 DC steps, bg_target=truth.
